Delhi Police Designates New Protest Sites, Bans Jantar Mantar

Delhi Police have issued an order prohibiting protests at Jantar Mantar, a popular demonstration site. In its place, three new designated locations have been established for public gatherings. The specific names of these new sites have been determined.
